objective: Read-only shadow qualification on the physical iMac of the existing VOS cloud bridge and local Ollama runtime. Record provenance-bound UTC and monotonic timestamps, bridge sync sequence before/after, machine/CPU/RAM/swap observations and Ollama eval_count/eval_duration/load_duration/total_duration in idle and explicitly bounded local-load phases. No code generation, hosted runner substitution, automated merge, production impact or new installed component.
acceptance_criteria: Validate this exact JSON with the upstream VOS frontier_inbox and mandate v1 schema; store exact SHA-256 of normalized mandate.
Verify actual physical iMac identity and actual installed bridge signature, configuration and launchd status before any load; absence of physical evidence is STOP, not PASS.
Verify the shadow project is attached under the original VOS contract and a matching immutable plan exists; otherwise record WAITING_PROJECT or WAITING_PLAN.
Capture for each phase >=5 UTC timestamps and corresponding monotonic clock readings and bridge control_sync sequence/synced_at_utc values; never substitute synthetic measurements.

Measure idle and model-load CPU, memory and swap using read-only macOS diagnostics; obtain Ollama actual eval_count/eval_duration/total_duration from localhost only and compute tokens/s from eval_duration.
Estimate incremental electrical consumption only if independently measured wattage is provided; otherwise report ENERGY_KWH=UNKNOWN, not 0.
Check that bridge persists exact mandate once and detects changed replay; no worker authorization, repo write, deployment, workflow dispatch or production effect.
Produce a provenance-bound receipt identifying all NOT_RUN and STOP gates, control commit, VOS runtime revision, worker model digest if used, cost and wall-clock latencies.
